objective: Auditar en modo solo lectura si la vista publica y las tablas de estado explican que SERVIDORES muestre menos conexiones y estados en rojo. Usar columnas explicitas y CAST. No exponer secretos, no modificar datos, no tocar TABLAJERIA.sys.*.

queries.name: public_view_visibility_summary
queries.sql: SELECT activo, visible_en_listado, visible_en_operaciones, system_type, tipo_conexion, COUNT(1) AS total_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_VW_Servidores_Conexiones_Publico GROUP BY activo, visible_en_listado, visible_en_operaciones, system_type, tipo_conexion ORDER BY total_rows DESC

queries.name: public_view_candidate_rows_safe
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CAST(id AS varchar(36)) AS id, nombre, system_type, tipo_conexion, host, port, database_name, activo, visible_en_operaciones, visible_en_listado, es_editable_ui, es_eliminable_ui, empresa_id, EmpresaID, sucursales, categorias, departamentos, tipos_movimiento, date_calculation_method, queries_configured, CONVERT(varchar(19), fecha_ultima_sincronizacion, 120) AS fecha_ultima_sincronizacion, source_status, ultimo_error_sync, CONVERT(varchar(19), created_at, 120) AS created_at, CONVERT(varchar(19), updated_at, 120) AS updated_at, created_by, updated_by, mongodb_id FROM dbo.Sistema_VW_Servidores_Conexiones_Publico WHERE nombre LIKE '%TABLAJ%' OR nombre LIKE '%CAVA%' OR nombre LIKE '%MPRO%' OR nombre LIKE '%CIENFUEGOS%' OR nombre LIKE '%ORIGEN%' OR database_name LIKE '%tablaj%' OR system_type LIKE '%MPRO%' OR system_type LIKE '%SOFT%' OR system_type LIKE '%TABLAJ%' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, created_at DESC

queries.name: conexion_estado_candidate_rows_safe
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CAST(Id AS varchar(36)) AS Id, CAST(ServidorID AS varchar(36)) AS ServidorID, ServerID, EstadoConexion, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimoCheck, 120) AS UltimoCheck, ResponseTimeMs, MongoId, ColeccionOrigen, MigradoDesdeMongo, CONVERT(varchar(19), FechaMigracionMongo, 120) AS FechaMigracionMongo, Activo, CONVERT(varchar(19), FechaCreacion, 120) AS FechaCreacion, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimaPruebaUTC, 120) AS UltimaPruebaUTC, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimoExitoUTC, 120) AS UltimoExitoUTC, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimoErrorUTC, 120) AS UltimoErrorUTC, UltimoErrorCodigo, UltimoErrorMensaje, LatenciaMs, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimoSyncUTC, 120) AS UltimoSyncUTC, CONVERT(varchar(19), UltimoSyncExitosoUTC, 120) AS UltimoSyncExitosoUTC, CONVERT(varchar(19), FechaActualizacionUTC, 120) AS FechaActualizacionUTC FROM dbo.Servidores_ConexionEstado ORDER BY FechaActualizacionUTC DESC, UltimaPruebaUTC DESC

queries.name: consultas_sql_servidores_count_by_server
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(ServidorID AS varchar(36)) AS ServidorID, EmpresaID, SucursalID, Activo, COUNT(1) AS total_consultas FROM dbo.ConsultasSQL_Servidores GROUP BY CAST(ServidorID AS varchar(36)), EmpresaID, SucursalID, Activo ORDER BY total_consultas DESC
